base.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a polished cinematic background painting for an interactive quantum image mixer.
Primary request: Create the CHERRY BLOSSOM WORLD version of Keio University's Kyoseikan (Collaboration Complex), Hiyoshi Campus, using the provided official photograph strictly as the architectural reference.
Input image 1: architectural and camera reference, the REAL sports-field-side facade of Kyoseikan. Keep the identifiable existing building, its wide symmetrical low stepped terraces, two square glass-fronted side wings, two long upper white-roofed blocks, and the small blue glass central atrium. It must unmistakably match this building, not a generic university or castle.
Composition: a single full-bleed landscape image, ultra-wide aspect ratio 5:2, ideally 2000 x 800 pixels. Keep the straight-on centered camera and bilateral architectural symmetry. Entire building remains within the frame with generous margins. Central atrium on the vertical centerline; main roofline around 38% image height, ground line around 78%; foreground plaza/field below. This will be the master camera for seven other world variants and the building will later be blended pixel for pixel.
Scene: the same Kyoseikan in a lush Japanese spring world, cherry blossom trees at both lateral edges, richly layered luminous pink blossoms, scattered petals around the foreground, emerald grass, soft distant trees. Trees frame rather than obscure the facade.
Style: beautiful premium video-game environment concept art with realistic architectural proportions and detailed glass, concrete, plants and atmospheric depth. Elegant cinematic matte painting, delicate natural textures, NOT flat vector art, NOT a cheap cartoon. Warm late-afternoon light, subtle bloom, pale pink and jade colors, inviting sense of wonder.
Constraints: no people, cars, text, lettering, badges, borders, grid, watermark, clock tower, ornate historical buildings, fake logos. Building silhouette and window pattern follow reference. Keep architecture clearly readable. Single image only. Opaque background.
